title: SCHC ACK tests omit distinct authenticated wrong-signer case
description: Correctness review: the test named wrong_peer never constructs a different remote signer, and signed-wire coverage checks only a wrong local receiver and a same-identity clone. Add a third known signer, receive its cryptographically valid ACK after session start, assert exact-sender rejection without consuming or advancing the target session, then prove the intended signer's ACK still succeeds.
